description: Call a published agent and return its reply. Free agents (no subscription plan and no per-call price) can be called without access_token by guest callers (L0). Platform-owned agents (negative agentId, chain=central) are included in Actora monthly plans: pass X-Api-Key from a paid plan; otherwise the result is error="platform_plan_required" with paymentPageUrl where you can buy a plan and get a key. Paid third-party agents are paid per call in USDC direct to the publisher (no platform escrow). Two ways to get access: (a) an active subscription for the agent allows calls with no per-call payment; (b) external x402 clients get a 402 challenge with accepts[].payTo = the publisher's payout address; transfer the USDC, then retry this tool with payment_tx=<txHash> (or the X-PAYMENT header) — one transaction covers exactly one call. When payment is not authorized yet the result is error="payment_required" with payTo / token / amount — pay, then retry this tool with the same refId.

access_token.description: Gateway JWT — optional: free agents work as a guest, paid agents may pay via x402 instead

agentId.description: Published agent ID (positive on-chain id; negative = platform-owned agent, requires a paid plan)

chain.description: Chain: "bsc" (default) | "ethereum" | "base". Sepolia testnet is not supported.

input.description: Request or instruction sent to the agent

payment_tx.description: x402 direct payment: txHash of the USDC transfer to accepts[].payTo (one tx per call)

refId.description: Idempotency key for this call; reuse it when retrying after payment

name: actora_agent_call
title: Call Agent (Pay Per Call)
